name: BTC Korea Premium Index
description: [(Korea Price - Global Price) / Global Price] × 100. Gap between Korean retail (Upbit) and global price. High premium = FOMO mania (contrarian sell signal). Low/negative = fear (contrarian buy signal).
trading_signal: >5% → Korean retail FOMOing (market top risk, contrarian exit). <0% → Korean retail fearful (market bottom risk, contrarian buy).
